title: Replace debug prints with structured logging across a package
spec:
OBJECTIVE
Every module under src/pkg/ has leftover debug print() calls that spam production logs and leak internal state to stdout. Replace each with a structured debug log call so the output can be filtered by level, without changing any behaviour the tests cover.

FILES
src/pkg/**/*.py. Do not modify tests/ or src/pkg/log.py.

INTERFACES
from pkg.log import log   # a logging.Logger named "pkg"
log.debug("message %s", value)   # use %-style lazy formatting, never f-strings inside log calls

CONSTRAINTS
- Zero print( calls remain under src/pkg/ except in src/pkg/log.py.
- Every replaced call keeps the same information (the message text and the values) as a log.debug call.
- No other behaviour changes. No new dependencies.
- The visible tests must still pass.

VERIFY
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q && ! grep -rn "^\s*print(" src/pkg --include=*.py | grep -v src/pkg/log.py

REASONING
as invoked
